scope: PSL, PSO and PSQ FORMAT fields represented by VCFv4.5 tables VCF5.8 and VCF5.9, including their relationship to PS and GT.

VCFv4_1.note: PS is present; PSL/PSO/PSQ are not present in the reviewed source context.

VCFv4_2.note: PS is present; PSL/PSO/PSQ are not present in the reviewed source context.

VCFv4_3.note: PS is present; PSL/PSO/PSQ are not present in the reviewed source context.

PSL.definition: A list of phase sets, one for each allele value specified in GT.
rules: Unphased alleles (without a preceding | separator) must have '.' in the corresponding list position.
Unlike PS (defined per CHROM), same phase-set names on different CHROM values are considered the same phase set.
When uniqueness cannot be guaranteed across a VCF, a CHROM*POS*ALLELE-NUMBER naming convention is recommended; the '*' delimiter is explained by a footnote.
A sample genotype must not contain both PS and PSL.
PS and PSL are not interoperable.
PSL.delta: VCFv4.5 changes 'allele specified in GT' to 'allele value specified in GT'; no material semantic change was identified in the reviewed clause.

PSO.definition: A list of phase-set ordinals defining the order in which variants are encountered when traversing a derivative chromosome.
rules: Missing value '.' represents a missing PSO value.
For each phase-set name, PSO should be defined if any allele with that name on any record is symbolic SV or in breakend notation.
Variants in breakend notation must have the same PSL and PSO on both records.
PSO.delta: No material wording or semantic change identified in the reviewed clauses.

PSQ.definition: List of PQ values, one for each phase set in PSL, encoded like PQ.
rules: In VCFv4.5, the missing value '.' should be used when the corresponding PSL value is missing or when phasing quality is unknown.
PSQ.delta: VCFv4.5 adds an explicit missing-value rule for PSQ; preserve its SHOULD force rather than converting it to MUST.

number_p.meaning: Number=P cardinality follows sample ploidy/local copy number; it is distinct from Number=G genotype-combination cardinality.

example_interpretation.status: INFORMATIVE_EXAMPLES; normative obligations are derived from field definitions and modal prose, not example rows.

remaining: Independent reviewer must confirm PS/PSL non-interoperability, cross-CHROM scope and per-GT-allele indexing.
Map PSL/PSO/PSQ to atomic requirement IDs and preserve SHOULD/MUST distinctions.
Add tests for missing/unphased alleles, duplicate phase-set names, cross-CHROM identity, PS/PSL conflict, PSO for breakends and PSQ missing/unknown quality.
